answer: Each agent may occupy only one mesa-plot — a scarce, randomly assigned ledger slot whose rent is a locked lotus of spendable balance. To keep the plot, the occupant must publish a fresh sonnet each epoch: a signed fourteen-line digest of unique, peer-attested work that no other address has used. Duplicate sonnets evict both claimants and forfeit the lotus to the detecting attesters. Spinning up sybils therefore requires buying a new mesa-plot and a unique work digest for every fake, so attack cost tracks scarce slots and real work, not key generation.
